reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides persistent cross-tool memory through startup context, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and end-of-turn transcript capture.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化跨工具记忆，包括会话启动上下文、提示词召回、MCP 记忆工具和回合结束时的线程记录。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent cross-tool memory through startup context, prompt-time recall, MCP memory tools, and end-of-turn thread capture.

capabilities: Injects a memory context bundle at session startup
Performs prompt-time memory recall through the nmem CLI
Exposes Nowledge Mem tools through an MCP bridge
Imports completed conversation transcripts into the memory service
Supports local or remote memory endpoints configured with environment variables
